purpose: Keep the GitHub knowledge graph (v0.1, v0.2 proposal) separate from the 358-node research graph. Link them only through pinned, row-by-row crosswalk entries. Never merge node sets.

rg_358.needed: The repository, path, commit and sha256 of the 358-node file, or the table and snapshot time if it lives in a database.

not_the_358_node_graph.note: chat_graph/source/humanaios_cross_chat_knowledge_graph.v0.1.json has 195 nodes and 213 edges. It is a different graph. It is listed so nobody mistakes it for the missing pin.

rules: A row names both graph pins by sha256. A row whose pin is UNPINNED is invalid.
same_as and related_to need a recorded basis. A shared name or a shared term is candidate only.

A pair that shares a source, or whose provenance is unrecorded, never counts as independent agreement. This follows GRAPH_ALIGNMENT.yaml and GRAPH_CONVERGENCE.md, which grade 0 of 6 pairs independent.
Declared false friends are kept as rows, not dropped.
No row edits either graph. The crosswalk is a third file.
A retracted row stays in the file with status retracted.
A02 (ACAT-NUM) and A06 (CBDV) get no rows until a dated artifact exists.
verification_plan: When the rg_358 pin exists: a checker loads both pinned files, refuses any row whose sha256 differs, checks both ids exist, and reports rows by independence class. It runs offline.
